claims: U.S. stock markets (NYSE and Nasdaq) are closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observation of Good Friday.
There will be no regular trading sessions on Friday, April 3, 2026.
U.S. stock markets (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Bond markets are open for an abbreviated session on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Bond markets are closing at noon ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Crypto markets are open on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Banks are generally open on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Mail is generally open on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
The next scheduled market closure is Monday, May 25, 2026, for Memorial Day.
